The GFx depth convention is inconsistent in this tree and is why the flag exists. Retail/GFx put a script-created clip at its AS depth + 16384 so it sits above every timeline depth, and `_depth`/getDepth subtract it. Here MCAttachMovie passes the AS depth through unchanged, MCGetDepth returns the raw internal depth, and GASop_DuplicateClip SUBTRACTS 16384 (GFxAS2Interp.cpp). Measured: the root's ten timeline children are at depths 1,50,68,72,93,95,96,97,98,99, so `>= 16384` cannot be used until attachMovie applies the offset. Hand-over to agent EX

Implemented and measured in this package: it does NOT fix the Options bug on its own (the clip is gone from the display list, so there is nothing to re-resolve to), so it was reverted to keep the GFx3 footprint minimal.
